title: Legend of the Virgin Mary landing on Athos at Iveron

tellings.quote: she got blown on the island of Monothos and there's a monastery on the placed on the site where she supposedly landed went ashore called Iveron

plain: A legend holds that the Virgin Mary was blown off course at sea and came ashore on Mount Athos, a peninsula of Orthodox monasteries in Greece, and that a monastery called Iveron now stands on the spot where she landed. Ralph Larson, a guest the episode bills as a former CIA chief, tells Michels this as something a monk at Iveron told him during a visit there in the mid-2000s. In Larson's words, "she got blown on the island" and the monastery was "placed on the site where she supposedly landed."
